syllabus.title: AITS:4 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Current Electricity, Moving Charges and Magnetism, Magnetism and Matter + AITS-3.

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Solution, Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics, Haloalkanes and Haloarenes, Alcohols, Ethers and Phenols + AITS-3.

📌 BOTANY
• Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plant, Molecular Basis of Inheritance + AITS-3

📌 ZOOLOGY
• Reproductive Health + AITS-3.
